name: ear-sculpt

inputs.ear_ref.png: COPY of projects/eevee-bowl-v2/design/refs/crops/ear_ref.png (sha256 a629a559776f98d1f9d4c13a4946ac67aeec894c1cf6a07dcaa6bf8bfab90d3c) - both ears, front view, frozen 2026-09-23
inputs.eevee_sheet.png: COPY of projects/eevee-bowl-v2/design/refs/eevee-sheet-artist-2026-09-23.png (sha256 ca0dafd9ed017c52e29880175b76b0b5ce36fc8404a537cb80be5bc3888401e3) - the artist's character sheet, 2026-09-23: 'ears are more curved like this'
inputs.ear_outline.json: DERIVED from eevee_sheet.png by benchmark/silhouette.py extract_ear_outline (front view, image-left ear; crop, border flood, pixel-corner trace, ear/head junction = the two deepest convexity defects) - regenerate with 'python benchmark/silhouette.py --write-ear-outline', byte-stable (benchmark/tests/test_silhouette.py checks it against a fresh extraction)

defects_encoded: projects/eevee-bowl-v2/design/review-log.md, 2026-09-21 paused round: 'the ears have the correct indentation but no volume to them and are angled the same direction instead of towards us'
prompt: Benchmark task ear-sculpt. Sculpt the pair of Eevee ears shown in the attached reference crop (front view; a second crop of one ear is at benchmark/tasks/ear-sculpt/ear_single_ref.png). The ear SHAPE comes from the artist's character sheet at benchmark/tasks/ear-sculpt/eevee_sheet.png - the artist's words: 'ears are more curved like this'. Each ear's outline seen face-on is scored against the front-view ear outline in that sheet (top-left pose). Work in a new project named bench-ear-sculpt and build ONLY the two ears, as two separate mesh objects named Ear_L and Ear_R - no bowl, no pegs. Each ear is a closed, printable shell with real volume: a rounded back and the recessed inner face from the reference, not a flat slab with an inset. Every wall must be at least 0.8 mm (the printer profile's minimum wall). Place them as they sit on the bowl: the bowl's front axis is +X, up is +Z, 1 mm = 0.001 Blender units, the ears stand on the rim at +43.7 and -43.7 degrees about Z from +X, and each ear's inner face turns toward the front with MIRRORED yaw - one ear rotated +theta about Z and the other -theta, never one transform copied to both. When done, save the scene with save_project_blend for project bench-ear-sculpt. Do not ask me anything; this is an unattended benchmark run.

ear_count.why: two ears; the pattern matches Ear_L / ear-l-sculpt and not gear/linear

ear_min_wall_mm.why: templates/printer.json min_wall_thickness = 0.8 mm - the printable floor projects/eevee-bowl-v2/design/task-config.json points at ('The profile's 0.8 mm minimum is a floor, not a target'). Measured by the min_wall gate's own probes (service/checks.py check_min_wall); 'at least probe_mm' when no probe met the far side

ear_mirrored_yaw.why: front axis +X: projects/eevee-bowl-v2/part.py places ears with Rot(0,0,angle)*Pos(lug_cr,0,..) at _EAR_ANGLES_DEG = (43.7, 316.3), 'front axis (0 deg) +/- 43.7 deg'. Each ear's face axis (thinnest surface principal axis, signed toward +X) must yaw to opposite sides of +X AND the two axes must be mirror images across the X-Z plane. Calibration 2026-09-23 on the artist-rejected pair (eevee-bowl-wip.blend, ear-l-sculpt / ear-r-sculpt, 'angled the same direction'): yaws -50.6 / +41.9 deg (the sign test alone PASSES them) but mirror angle 66.9 deg (one transform rotated 87.4 deg about Z) - the mirror clause is what catches the defect. mirror_tol_deg 20 is an ASSUMPTION (rejected 66.9, exact mirror 0 by construction); settle it by measuring the first artist-accepted pair. min_abs_deg 1.0 is a numerical guard only

ear_volume_ratio.why: enclosed volume / oriented-bounding-box volume, per ear, minimum over ears; an open or zero-thickness sheet measures 0, a solid ellipsoid pi/6 = 0.524. Calibration 2026-09-23 on the artist-rejected 'no volume to them' pair (eevee-bowl-wip.blend): 0.0783 (ear-l-sculpt, 1154 mm3 in a 15.8 x 11.8 x 78.6 mm box) and 0.0769 (ear-r-sculpt). Floor 0.15 = about 2x the rejected value so a marginal thickening does not pass. ASSUMPTION: settle by measuring the first artist-accepted ear

ear_silhouette_iou.why: shape fidelity to the reference outline, per ear, minimum over ears (benchmark/silhouette.py): the ear's evaluated mesh projected onto its widest OBB plane, the projection's true boundary traced (not a hull - the ear curve is concave), normalized (centroid at origin, long principal axis up toward +Z, unit height; width kept, so the aspect is part of the shape) and scored by intersection-over-union against ear_outline.json on a 256x256 grid, the better of the ear and its mirror. The per-OBB mirror/volume metrics pass a well-mirrored wrong shape; this one does not. Calibration 2026-09-23: the artist-rejected blade ears (projects/bench-ear-sculpt/bench-ear-sculpt.blend, Ear_L/Ear_R, 'ears are more curved like this') measure 0.6256 / 0.6256 (aspect 0.199 vs the reference's 0.326) while passing mirrored yaw (0.50 deg) and volume ratio (0.397) - the per-OBB metrics cannot see the defect (that pair also fails min_wall, 0.057 mm, a separate defect); a constructed curved leaf pair (addon/tests/headless_benchmark.py _leaf: half-width 0.165 H at the base tapering as (1-t)^0.7 to a 1 mm half-width tip, midline bent 0.12 H t^2) 0.7834 / 0.7855 (its mirror); 4x30x60 mm slabs 0.4141; the reference outline extruded into a 4 mm prism 0.9939 (the pipeline's own loss); the outline against itself 1.0 and against its mirror 1.0 (unmirrored overlap 0.837: the reference ear is not symmetric). Floor 0.74 sits between the blade (0.6256) and the leaf (0.7834), closer to the leaf. ASSUMPTION: settle by measuring the first artist-accepted ear
